name: pipeline-kline-roundtrip-fees
description: Bar-path counterpart of pipeline-long-roundtrip-fees.json: the same canonical numbers, but the runner replays closed 1m Kline bars instead of ticks. Each signal's price and timestamp becomes a flat-OHLC bar's close and timestamp, driven through a kline strategy and the production execution pipeline, with the same fee math (0.1% on both sides) as the ticker fixture. It pins that the bar path reuses the pipeline and is not a second simulator.
